# Cleveland 2001.79, illustrated border leaf

A silver acanthus scroll with red and blue flowers from the border of a Rouen Book of Hours leaf of about 1510, in the Cleveland Museum of Art.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `cma-2001-79`, historical, 1 asset.
